title: sym_key_export_private is dead code — key_exportable always 0
description: fd.c:1800: ioctl_do_kdf hardcodes state->key_exportable = 0 for SYMMETRIC KEY fds. There is no UAPI path to set exportable=1 — the struct crypto2dev_kdf_op has no 'exportable' field. Therefore sym_key_export_private() (fd.c:1513) is unreachable: ioctl_key_export_private checks \!state->key_exportable and returns -EACCES. Dead code violates project policy (CLAUDE.md). Fix: either add 'exportable' field to struct crypto2dev_kdf_op and wire it up, or remove sym_key_export_private and NULL the ops slot.
